items.title: Hypolite Charles Interview, 1963-04-13
items.q: look when we had the Maple Leaf band, Cantrell was playing in there. You talk about a drummer.

ctx.x: player. Welch. Welch. You know something I don't understand about Henry Martin now. You remember Alfred Williams, a drummer, he's always talking about how great Henry Martin was you know, and what a wonderful drummer he was. Why did he switch to banjo? No, no.

Henry Martin couldn't play no drums. No? No. He played the drum. You know a drummer, not to say talk about it, but a drummer, he's got to be fast. A drummer can't lag. A drummer can make you play music. Or you can play if you've got a drummer. That's right. Oh my goodness. That's why my band used to run. One Red was playing with me that was a dead band. But when Welch got in there, but look when we had the Maple Leaf band, Cantrell was playing in there. You talk about a drummer.
